national_news.title: Defence Minister Highlights Evolving Security Threats and Indigenisation at Bagdogra
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed Air Force personnel at Bagdogra, emphasizing the strategic importance of the region in safeguarding North-Eastern India.
Highlighted the changing nature of modern warfare, noting that security threats now extend beyond conventional borders to include cyberattacks, drone warfare, proxy wars, and information warfare.
Stressed the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat, emphasizing the key role of Indian startups and domestic industries in manufacturing drones, anti-drone systems, and advanced defense tech.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Confirms E20 Petrol Meets BIS IS 17021 Standards
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas clarified that E20 petrol supplied by public sector Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) strictly complies with Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specification IS 17021.
Comprehensive nationwide testing of 893 samples across 27 States and Union Territories confirmed that ethanol blending levels remained consistently within the prescribed 19% to 20% range.
The statement directly refuted claims regarding excessive ethanol content in fuel, reassuring consumers about quality control across distribution networks.

national_news.title: PM Felicitates Asian Para Games Contingent; Highlights TOPS and Khelo India Ecosystem
bullets: India achieved a record-breaking tally of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze) along with 5 world records and 9 Asian records at the Asian Para Games.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the role of grassroot programs, Khelo India Centres, and the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) in building a modern sports ecosystem aimed at Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
Women athletes showcased exceptional performance with 34 out of 56 female participants securing medals, alongside strong debut performances where 36 out of 61 first-time competitors won medals.

national_news.title: Government Integrates Startup India and I-STEM Portals to Boost R&D Access
bullets: The Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA), led by Prof. Ajay Kumar Sood, launched an API integration between the 'Startup India' portal and the 'I-STEM' (Indian Science, Technology and Engineering Facilities Map) portal.
The initiative, undertaken with DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce and Industry), allows DPIIT-recognised startups to seamlessly discover and access national scientific research and testing facilities.
The synergy aims to significantly lower research and development (R&D) costs, prevent duplication of costly equipment, and ensure optimal utilization of publicly funded scientific infrastructure.

national_news.title: IAF Partners with IIT Madras to Develop Indigenous Airborne Communication System
bullets: The Indian Air Force's (IAF) Software Development Institute signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) with IIT Madras and IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation.
The collaboration will focus on designing and developing an indigenous, secure digital communication system tailored for airborne applications and networked warfare operational environments.
Key development areas include advanced encryption protocols, resilient data transmission, and seamless integration with existing defence networks to promote self-reliance under Atmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: Government Approves 2-Year Extension and Permanent Absorption Option for Agniveers
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that Agniveers will be granted an additional two-year extension beyond their initial four-year tenure, enabling eligibility for permanent regular enrolment.
Upon completion of the full six-year service period, all serving Agniveers meeting physical fitness, discipline, and selection criteria will be eligible for regular service absorption.
Launched in June 2022 for candidates aged 17.5 to 21 years, the original Agnipath scheme mandated a four-year engagement period with a provision to retain only 25% of recruits in regular service.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Emphasizes Emerging Warfare Preparedness at Bagdogra IAF Station
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel at Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, highlighting the strategic significance of the region in securing North-Eastern India.
Stressed the shift in modern warfare toward non-conventional threats, including cyberattacks, drone warfare, proxy wars, and information warfare.
Emphasized indigenous technological development under 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat', focusing on startups developing anti-drone systems and advanced defense equipment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces 83-km Ganga Riverfront Road Between Munger and Bhagalpur
bullets: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the upcoming construction of an 83-km Ganga riverfront road connecting Munger and Bhagalpur.
The proposed project aims to boost regional connectivity, support local development, and help manage recurring flood impacts on agricultural lands along the Ganga corridor.
The announcement was made during the Munger Deepotsav, alongside the state government's vision to expand domestic employment and business opportunities by 2030 to curb outward migration.

bihar_news.title: NHAI to Pilot Barrier-Free Toll Collection on NH-31 in Bihar
bullets: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) selected NH-31 in Bihar for an initial trial of a technology-based, barrier-free toll collection system.
The initiative utilizes Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras and GPS-linked vehicle data to implement a 'Pay for the Distance Travelled' tolling model.
Managed by NPCI and NHAI, FASTag was launched as a pilot in 2014 and became mandatory across all Indian toll plazas in 2021.

bihar_news.title: TERI Partners with BSPGCL for Renewable Energy and Storage Solutions in Bihar
bullets: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Bihar State Power Generation Company Limited (BSPGCL) during the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit 2026.
The MoU focuses on developing energy storage infrastructure (battery and pumped storage) and advanced solar applications including AgriPV, building-integrated, and rail/road-integrated photovoltaics.
TERI also finalized clean energy transition agreements with West Bengal to establish EV charging corridors and AgriPV frameworks.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Enhances Rural Water Tower Solar Panel Capacity to 20 kW
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed officials to increase the solar panel capacity on rural water towers under the Chief Minister Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana from 5 kW to 20 kW.
The solarization scheme will be executed by the Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA), which will oversee implementation, monitoring, and maintenance.
Funding for the project and the solarization of Panchayat Sarkar buildings will be linked to allocations from the 15th Finance Commission and the 7th State Finance Commission.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Becomes First State to Launch Comprehensive Silt Management Policy 2026
bullets: Bihar launched the 'Bihar Water Sources Restoration and Silt Management Policy, 2026', becoming the first Indian state to formulate a comprehensive framework for scientific river desilting and flood risk reduction.

Under the 'Nadi Sanjeevani Initiative', an MoU was signed between MoRTH and Bihar to utilize 243 lakh cubic metres of excavated river silt across 16 ongoing National Highway projects, with Bihar RCD as the nodal agency.
The policy provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 per two hectares to farmers for excavating sand and silt deposited on agricultural land.

bihar_news.title: NHAI and Bihar Government Sign MoU to Use River Silt for Highway Construction
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) and the Bihar government signed an MoU for scientifically desilting water bodies under the initiative 'Nadi Sanjivani, Nadi Punarjeevan, Sadak Navnirman'.
The initiative aims to address silt accumulation, seasonal flooding, and construction material shortages in rivers such as the Ganga, Kosi, Gandak, Falgu, and Bagmati.
Under the agreement, 39.3 million cubic metres of silt will be provided free of cost for ongoing highway projects, with another 105 million cubic metres planned for future projects.
The project draws inspiration from Maharashtra’s 'Buldhana Pattern' of using excavated soil for highway earthwork while deepening water bodies.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Mandates Pre-Serving Tasting and Certification for Midday Meals
bullets: Bihar's Directorate of Mid-Day Meal Scheme directed headmasters and teachers-in-charge of government and aided schools to taste and certify meals before serving.
Designated officials must maintain a signed daily record certifying that the food was tasted, satisfactory, and fit for consumption for verification by District Education Officers.
If senior officials are absent, a nominated teacher must complete the mandatory tasting to ensure uninterrupted daily quality compliance.
